proof_summary: Take the counterexample \(n=2^{14}\cdot4409\cdot458009=33085221781504\), whose prime-power factors are pairwise coprime. Multiplicativity gives \(\sigma(n)=66183576284700\) and \(\sum_{d\mid n}\sigma(d)=132367152569399\), so \(a(n)=2\sigma(n)-\sum_{d\mid n}\sigma(d)=1\), although \(n\ne1,12\).
